description: Intentional insult or intimidation with intent to humiliate a member of SC/ST in any place within public view
Abuses any member of SC/ST by caste name in any place within public view
Intentionally touching a woman belonging to SC/ST without her consent, using sexual acts/words
Committing any offence under IPC punishable with imprisonment for 10 years or more against a person or property on ground that such person is a member of SC/ST
Committing any offence specified in Schedule against person/property knowing that such person is a member of SC/ST
Punishment for neglect of duties (by public servant)
Special Court and Exclusive Special Court
Appeals (Appeal lies to High Court from any judgment/sentence/order, including bail, within 90 days)
Section 438 of the Code not to apply to persons committing an offence under the Act (Bar on Anticipatory Bail)
No enquiry or approval required for arrest; Section 438 not applicable notwithstanding any court judgment/order.
